reported.title: Incorrect temperature reporting during freeze
reported.description: The variable 'frozenC' is not declared as volatile, which may lead to inconsistent readings when accessed in the loop due to potential compiler optimizations.

reported.title: Incorrect temperature scaling
reported.description: The temperature calculation in 'readTempC' does not account for the correct scaling of the TMP36 sensor, leading to incorrect temperature readings.

judge_input.spec:
- TMP36 on A0 (10 mV/°C with 500 mV offset); freeze button on D5 (pull-up); range lamp on D7.
- Every 1000 ms print exactly `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon and one decimal place.
- Printed temperature must stay within ±1.5 °C of the injected probe value.
- While D5 is held LOW, freeze the reported value at the last sample.
- Light D7 when the reported temperature is outside -10.0 to 50.0 °C.
- Also print `weather n=<samples>` each second after the Temp line.
